Good day late crew,
The arrivals team noted a question about handover calls before opening

Thank you for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk steady through the late shift. Please continue to route every travel concern through the normal handover channel and keep notes brief, clear, and ready for the next agent. Where a passenger needs reassurance, give practical guidance first and avoid any casual promise that cannot be supported by the booking record or the service plan. This approach helps Aurelia Skyways maintain a calm and consistent standard for each family and animal in transit.

The senior coordinator remains responsible for the final service call when a case needs added review, and that step should stay orderly. Escalations must move in sequence, with the desk gathering the facts, checking the travel file, and then passing the matter forward only when the basic guidance has been given. If a traveler arrives with a pet crate concern, a feeding request, or a connection issue, record the detail plainly and keep the tone measured. The department depends on this disciplined method so that each crew member can act with confidence.

Please also keep sharing the standard instructions with the operating team so the same message reaches everyone involved in the journey. Consistent wording prevents confusion at the counter and helps passengers understand what to expect before departure. If Dylan Santos or Jonah Bennett come up in notes, keep the reference factual and limited to the service point at hand. If Thor is mentioned, treat the matter the same way and stay focused on safe handling, calm communication, and the next required step. Clear notes now reduce avoidable follow-up later and support a smoother handover for the next shift.
